title: 中国电网才20年：美欧已40年，AI基建成本差在哪？
speaker: Matty Jiao

segments.en: And then in terms of China advantage obviously China has a dominant you know market share in terms of the key materials for example we have 50% of refined copper 70% of red earth 70% of IMP which is essential for the laser in the optical sides.
segments.zh: 就中国优势而言，中国在关键材料上市场份额占主导，例如精炼铜占50%，稀土占70%，IMP占70%，这对光学领域的激光器至关重要。

segments.en: And we are also you know younger in terms of the power grid China is only 20 years in the grid side versus US in Europe around 40 to above years as well and power is cheaper power is 40 to 60% cheaper and at the same time I would say that the integrated industrial basis means that once you break through the technology the cost advantages and the easier to increase capacity is also quite fast.
segments.zh: 而且我们在电网方面更年轻，中国电网仅20年，而美欧约40年以上，电力更便宜，便宜40%到60%，同时一体化工业基础意味着一旦技术突破，成本优势和产能扩张也相当快。

segments.en: So just to compare the numbers you mentioned 350 billion 2030 that's in China and the world is 2.2 trillion that's about 15% is the main difference because of funding constraints or is it also because it's just cheaper to build these things in China.
segments.zh: 对比数字，你提到2030年中国3500亿，全球2.2万亿，约15%的主要差异是因为资金约束，还是因为中国建设成本更低？

segments.en: China so I think it's both both of this like particular what perspective on build out China is much lower like I said power is only 40% of the US right and then you also have you know enough power basically means that you're not going to build too much of power as well like China comes for one third of global power and 50% of renewables and at the same time labor cost and the borrowing cost now is also a lot cheaper considering that as well.
segments.zh: 中国我认为两者都有，从建设角度看中国成本低得多，如我所说电力仅美国的40%，而且足够电力意味着不会过度建设，中国占全球电力三分之一和可再生能源50%，同时劳动力成本和借贷成本现在也低得多。

segments.en: And then and then of course our basis is based on how much funding is available so there is a possibility if funding is more available this capital number can be higher than my assumption.
segments.zh: 当然我们的基础取决于可用资金，所以如果资金更充足，这个资本数字可能高于我的假设。

segments.en: Yeah like I said actually just on how much you need to build out we expect next five years to grow for time but the funding is currently is only going to be available for to grow at three times.
segments.zh: 是的，如我所说，仅就建设需求而言，我们预计未来五年增长四倍，但目前资金仅支持增长三倍。

segments.en: How do you see that I mean we're just talking about some pretty steep moves across some of the AI hardware space in China right now I think we're like 50% off the peaks of some of these stocks when it comes to the optalings and the like.
segments.zh: 你怎么看？我们刚才谈到中国AI硬件领域一些大幅波动，目前光模块等权益资产较峰值下跌约50%。
